threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when a bus driver grumbles at you for not having the right change. Everyone else knows to keep 50p handy.
Heard a couple arguing about whether KFC or McDonald's is better. By the time we hit Clapham, they'd switched to singing old Spice Girls songs. Quite the ride!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Watching a guy fix his bicycle by the corner store while a stray cat sunbathes on the pavement. That's Neukölln magic right there.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you catch a party in a former power plant while hearing the U-Bahn rumble underground. It's a vibe all its own.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their ability to navigate BART delays with a coffee in hand, while the newcomers go into full meltdown mode.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 at Civic Center today, a dog decided to take a nap on the tracks. Only in SF do we stop for a snoozing pup.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about the parks and squares, but miss the hidden art galleries tucked in old shops along Carrer de Verdi.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their confused looks at the TMB maps; locals know the shortcuts and which stops to skip.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus even when the Tube's down, not realizing the 38 is quicker. Everyone knows 'overground' is not just a train line but a lifestyle.
Caught a lad on the 59 last night, loudly boasting about his 'secret' karaoke spot in Clapham. Can't say I was impressed, but the bus drivers were all in on it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was really home when I saw the spontaneous dance party on the street during the bus strike—everyone laughing, helping each other out with rides.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst at 3 AM and watch street artists transform a post-war building into a canvas overnight.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local knows not to panic when the BART goes down; we just hop on the nearest taco truck and wait it out like it’s part of our commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading Muni riders with a ukulele at Civic Center, totally oblivious to the chaos around him. Just another day in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists miss that the real pa amb tomàquet is made with raw, dried bread, not toasted. You can spot locals’ disdain when they see the soggy versions served everywhere.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their overuse of 'gràcies' even when ordering a simple café. Locals skip the pleasantries to save time.
